name: @lumabri/qvac-adapter
description: QVAC plugin for Lumabri distributed MoE over a native gateway. npm package is JS-only; Lumabri gateway patches and builds require a git clone (see docs/native-build.md).

scripts.bundle: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/bundle.mts
scripts.bundle:cli: npm run build && node node_modules/@qvac/cli/dist/index.js bundle sdk
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run typecheck && npm run check:types && npm run check:contracts && npm run check:hygiene && npm test
scripts.check:contracts: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/check-contracts.mts && node --import tsx scripts/render-contracts.mts --check
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/gateway-client.test.ts test/native-upstream-state.test.ts test/prompt.test.ts test/provider-pool.test.ts
scripts.test:qvac: npm run build && node --import tsx test/qvac-e2e.mts
scripts.test:qvac:ssh: npm run build && node --import tsx test/qvac-ssh-e2e.mts
scripts.test:physical: npm run build && node --import tsx test/physical-provider-e2e.mts
